title.full: Paying for wisdom tooth removal with MediSave

summary.text: Yes, if it is a surgical procedure at a participating private dental clinic under the MediSave Scheme.

details.heading: Day surgery limit
details.body: Up to $830 per day for daily hospital charges, including investigations, medicines and doctor's attendance fees.

details.heading: Operation limit
details.body: The fixed limit is from $240 to $5,290, depending on the type of operation performed.

example_phrasings: Can I use MediSave to pay for the removal of my wisdom tooth?
Can MediSave pay for wisdom tooth removal?

sources.page_title: Can I use MediSave to pay for the removal of my wisdom tooth?

quotes.text: You can use your MediSave savings to pay for the removal of your wisdom tooth incurred at a participating private dental clinic under the MediSave Scheme, provided that it is a surgical procedure.
Day surgeryUp to a maximum of $830 per day for daily hospital charges, including investigations, medicines and doctor's attendance fees.
OperationA fixed limit for operations ranging from $240 to $5,290 depending on the type of operations performed.
